fields.label: SKILL.md content
fields.default:
# Notes Editing Workflow

Private workspace skill for reading and updating notes in a note-taking workspace.

## Reading a note

Use `view_note` to read the note before any edit. Never guess at content or offsets.

## Editing a note

Use `replace_note_content` with a `replace_text` operation. Prefer a targeted `find` over rewriting a whole note.

## Related tools

- `search_channels` - find team spaces
- `search_channel_messages` - find prior team discussion
- `view_channel_thread` / `view_channel_message` - read channel context

## Safety

- Never invent note content or offsets.
- Re-read the note if it changed between reads.
- Keep edits literal and scoped.
fields.help: Full markdown with frontmatter name and description
